description: Snow Plow Activity (2018-2020) is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Pittsburgh. Snow Plow GPS readings during declared City of Pittsburgh Snow Events. Includes readings on plow (up or down) and salt spreader speed. Please note: The system tracking snow plows was not fully deployed for the 2018-2019 or 2019-2020 seasons. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher City of Pittsburgh. Its tags are environment, events, plowing, plows, salt. It offers 31 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2024-06-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
